sub_answers.text: She transitioned from leading and varied roles to primarily playing mother roles later in her career [d15550665s2p0]. Tulasi explicitly decided to quit regular acting after marriage and later accepted mother character roles which became her screen identity [d41179500s1p0].

sub_answers.text: She became known for mother roles, especially in Telugu and Tamil films, and later took many supporting mother parts after marriage [d41179500s1p0]. She achieved a notable screen-mother identity following her Kannada hit Excuse Me and subsequent Kannada films [d41179500s1p0]. She also played varied roles earlier in her career, including praised character performances such as Chellamma that critics called "brilliant" and "career best" [d41179500s1p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: How did box-office performance and critical reception vary for her films across the three industries?
sub_answers.text: Her Kannada film Excuse Me was a big hit and led to increased offers and steady work in Kannada cinema [d41179500s1p0]. Critics praised some of her supporting performances in Telugu and Tamil, with specific roles earning strong critical notices such as Chellamma being called "brilliant" [d41179500s1p0]. Other films brought mixed commercial results but continued critical recognition for particular roles, which reshaped her career toward character and mother roles [d41179500s1p0].

Voice artists play a substantial role in South Indian cinema, as exemplified by Sunitha Upadrashta who dubbed for more than 110 actresses in over 750 films in the Telugu industry [d11564688s3p0].
